units.rawText: Dear <color=orange>De Lacey</color>,
units.displayText: Dear De Lacey,

spans.text: Dear
De Lacey

units.rawText:
I told you before that we'd have no problem with starting over. <|>
But now as it seems, without shelter to hide under, it's been nigh impossible for us to find work with the same degree of earnings as before in a new place.
units.displayText:

spans.text: I told you before that we'd have no problem with starting over.
But now as it seems, without shelter to hide under, it's been nigh impossible for us to find work with the same degree of earnings as before in a new place.

units.rawText:
You said that we don't have to return the repair fees from before, but it won't do for us to give up that easily. <|>
And we'll have to save up money for the future, then find some way to safely upgrade their neural clouds... We can only find work in these little roadside performances. The pay's not much at all, but we get to do it often, and it's much more flexible than before.

units.rawText:
These performance scenarios aren't so bad after all; the me from before would never have thought like that. At least, they are still here with me. <|>
We have no more big names to shield us, but so have we departed from yesterday's sorrows. <|>
Perhaps one day, their neural capacity and processing power will finally be upgraded to my level.

units.rawText:
I eagerly await that day. When it comes, I'll invite you and everyone else at the repair center to come see our performance. <|>
If one wanted a roadside performance to be of this caliber, we're perhaps the only group in the whole wide world who can meet those standards.

units.rawText: As the Ceremonial Orchestra's conductor, it would be inconceivable for me to be thrown off by such a minor incident.
units.displayText: As the Ceremonial Orchestra's conductor, it would be inconceivable for me to be thrown off by such a minor incident.

spans.text: As the Ceremonial Orchestra's conductor, it would be inconceivable for me to be thrown off by such a minor incident.

units.rawText: Just like me, you are all members of this orchestra. You should pay more mind to your own actions instead of wasting your processing power on worrying about me.
units.displayText: Just like me, you are all members of this orchestra. You should pay more mind to your own actions instead of wasting your processing power on worrying about me.

units.rawText: It's no big deal if we don't get to see her this time. I'm no longer just an empty shell.
units.displayText: It's no big deal if we don't get to see her this time. I'm no longer just an empty shell.

spans.text: It's no big deal if we don't get to see her this time. I'm no longer just an empty shell.

units.rawText: We all have our own direction to follow. So long as we walk our path, we'll meet again some day.

units.rawText: Casting her sight towards the horizon, the audience below expectantly waits for something new.
units.displayText: Casting her sight towards the horizon, the audience below expectantly waits for something new.

spans.text: Casting her sight towards the horizon, the audience below expectantly waits for something new.

units.rawText: As a Doll designed to service people of high society, the sight before her is still a bit unavoidably foreign, even if it had become something of a common scene for her in recent times.
units.displayText: As a Doll designed to service people of high society, the sight before her is still a bit unavoidably foreign, even if it had become something of a common scene for her in recent times.

units.rawText: (But... music can be performed in a recycling yard, as it can be here. No matter where we are, we'll hold our heads high and continue to perform.)

units.rawText: She strides forth, ready to perform once more.
units.displayText: She strides forth, ready to perform once more.

spans.text: She strides forth, ready to perform once more.

units.rawText: Perhaps it's no longer needing to gain the favor of an overseer and tread on thin ice, or maybe it's no longer needing to perform for days on end with no rest, but Undine thinks that she and her aides have never been in better shape.
units.displayText: Perhaps it's no longer needing to gain the favor of an overseer and tread on thin ice, or maybe it's no longer needing to perform for days on end with no rest, but Undine thinks that she and her aides have never been in better shape.

spans.text: Perhaps it's no longer needing to gain the favor of an overseer and tread on thin ice, or maybe it's no longer needing to perform for days on end with no rest, but Undine thinks that she and her aides have never been in better shape.

units.rawText: (I understand now that for me, what is most important is not those vainglorious fabrications.)
units.displayText: I understand now that for me, what is most important is not those vainglorious fabrications.

spans.text: I understand now that for me, what is most important is not those vainglorious fabrications.

units.rawText: (There's no need to be at the whim of another, no more need to live chattering in fear. Our new lives lie here, in our own hands.)
units.displayText: There's no need to be at the whim of another, no more need to live chattering in fear. Our new lives lie here, in our own hands.

spans.text: There's no need to be at the whim of another, no more need to live chattering in fear. Our new lives lie here, in our own hands.

units.rawText: (My most important companions... have always been by my side. This is how it is, and how it will be.)
